messages.subject: Replace legend labels for "high" and "low"
parts:
Dear all,

I'm plotting a map using ggplot2 and results are pretty neat, but there is one thing in the legend I need to change. Please take a look at this code, which is similar to the one I'm using except I have a actual map instead of a synthetic one:

library(raster)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

# generate raster data
r <- raster(ncol=384, nrow=190)
r <- setValues(r, rnorm(ncell(r), 10))

# convert raster to dataframes for plotting with ggplot2
map.p <- rasterToPoints(r); df <- data.frame(map.p)
colnames(df) <- c('longitude', 'latitude', 'values')

# create plot
p <- ggplot(df) +
       geom_raster(data=df, aes(longitude, latitude, fill=values)) +
       scale_fill_gradientn(colours=rev(brewer.pal(9,"RdBu"))) +
       scale_x_continuous(name=expression(paste("Longitude (",degree,")")), expand=c(0,0)) +
       scale_y_continuous(name=expression(paste("Latitude   (",degree,")")), expand=c(0,0)) +
       coord_equal()

print(p)

My question is: is there any way to replace the legend labels for just "high" at the top of the legend and "low" at the bottom?

Many thanks in advance,
Thiago.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Replace legend labels for "high" and "low"
parts: Maybe something like this??

ggplot(df) +
geom_raster(data=df, aes(longitude, latitude, fill=values)) +

scale_fill_gradientn(breaks = seq(6, 14, by = 2),
labels = c("Low", "", "", "", "High"),

colours=rev(brewer.pal(9,"RdBu"))) +
scale_x_continuous(name=expression(paste("Longitude
(",degree,")")), expand=c(0,0)) +
scale_y_continuous(name=expression(paste("Latitude
(",degree,")")), expand=c(0,0)) +
coord_equal()

You might want to reduce the number of breaks to improve its
appearance...up to you.

Dennis
